title: C-level leadership for AI ventures — in exchange for equity, not capital.
subtitle: Attolloo Group is an asset-light venture studio and competence investor. We contribute senior executive depth (CEO, CSO, HR Director) and validated frameworks in exchange for equity or performance-based revenue shares — not dilutive capital.
